## Review checklist

Mirrors [DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/mobile-mesh-ews/blob/main/DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md).

- [ ] Claims are labelled as fact, proposal, assumption, target, or verified result.
- [ ] No statement implies operational alerting, authority approval, live data, or autonomous physical action.
- [ ] Quantitative statements identify test conditions, evidence, version, date, limitations, and reviewer, or are labelled targets.
- [ ] Standard and provider references link to authoritative sources and do not overstate conformance or affiliation.
- [ ] Internal links are relative; added or renamed headings update the affected anchors.
- [ ] Requirements, risks, decisions, and references were updated together with the change.
- [ ] Examples contain no secrets, personal data, or third-party material without permission.
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_links.py`, `python3 tools/check_rtm.py`, and `python3 tools/check_mermaid.py` pass locally.
